unitTitle: Plurals - Countable/Uncountable Nouns - How Much/How Many - A Few/A Little - Some/Any

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  She WATCH TV every afternoon.  →  WATCHES

XATO TURLARI:

  1) 3-SHAXS -S yo'q
       She watch → WATCHES;  He live → LIVES

  2) NOTO'G'RI ZAMON
       'at the moment' bor → Present Continuous kerak
       They have dinner → ARE HAVING

  3) 'BE' shakli mos emas
       She ARE having → IS having

  4) 'CAN' dan keyin -S
       I can speakS → SPEAK

  5) A FEW / A LITTLE noto'g'ri
       a few milk → A LITTLE (sanalmaydigan)

  6) SOME / ANY noto'g'ri
       haven't got SOME → ANY (inkor)
       Can I have ANY tea? → SOME (iltimos)

  7) HOW MUCH / HOW MANY noto'g'ri
       How many ham → How MUCH

  8) Egalik OLMOSHI o'rniga SIFATI kerak
       mine umbrella → MY umbrella

items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob.
'She' — birlik 3-shaxs → WATCHES (-ch → -ES).

items.textEn: 2  They have dinner at the moment. → ............
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS kerak.
'They' — ko'plik → ARE + having.
'have dinner' — HARAKAT, shuning uchun -ing mumkin.

'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — -S QO'ShILMAYDI.
'I can SPEAK Italian.'

items.textEn: 4  There's a few milk in the fridge. → ............
items.whyUz:
'milk' — SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE.
'a few' faqat sanaladigan otlar bilan.
Fe'l 'There'S' ham buni tasdiqlaydi (birlik).

'He' — birlik 3-shaxs → LIVES.
'Brighton' — Angliyaning janubidagi dengiz bo'yi shahri.

items.textEn: 6  She are having lunch with Judy at the moment. → ............
items.whyUz:
'She' — birlik → IS having ('are' XATO).
Zamon to'g'ri tanlangan — 'at the moment' bor.

INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi.
'I haven't got ANY apples.'

items.textEn: 8  How many ham do you need? → ............
items.whyUz:
'ham' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
36-betdagi 5-mashqning 5-bandi bilan bir xil.

items.textEn: 9  Can I have any tea, please? → ............
items.whyUz: 'Can I have ...?' — ILTIMOS (request) → SOME.

items.hintUz: Ot bor — sifat kerakmi yoki olmoshmi?
items.whyUz:
OT bor ('umbrella') → egalik SIFATI kerak: MY.
'mine' — egalik OLMOSHI, otsiz ishlatiladi:
  'This umbrella is MINE.'
  'This is MY umbrella.'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  A: DO THEY play computer games?
     B: Yes, they DO.

QOLIP:
  SAVOL: Do/Does + ega + fe'l?
  JAVOB: Yes, + ega + do/does.
         No,  + ega + don't/doesn't.

'DO' yoki 'DOES':
  he, she, it, ism (birlik) → DOES
  I, you, we, they, ko'plik → DO

DIQQAT — 3-BAND BOSHQACHA:
  'What ...... your sisters like?' — bu 'be' bilan savol!
  'What are they LIKE?' = ular qanday odam? (xarakteri haqida)
  'Do they LIKE ...?' = ular ...ni yoqtiradimi?
  Ikki BUTUNLAY boshqa savol.

items.textEn: 1  A: ............ play computer games?  B: Yes, they ............ .
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'they' — ko'plik → DO.

Javobda 'she' → savolda ham 'she'.
'she' — birlik 3-shaxs → DOES.
DIQQAT: 'does' bor bo'lsa 'like' ga -S qo'shilmaydi.

items.textEn: 3  A: What ............ your sisters like?  B: ............ very friendly and polite.
items.whyUz:
'What are they LIKE?' = ular qanday odam? (xarakter savoli).
'your sisters' — KO'PLIK → ARE.
Javob: 'They are (They're) very friendly and polite.'
DIQQAT: 'What do they like?' bo'lsa 'nimani yoqtiradi?' bo'lardi.

'they' — ko'plik → DO.
INKOR javob: 'No, they DON'T.'
'camping' — 'like' dan keyin -ing shakli.

items.textEn: 5  A: ............ Mary like going shopping?  B: No, she ............ .
items.whyUz:
'Mary' — birlik 3-shaxs → DOES.
INKOR javob: 'No, she DOESN'T.'
'go shopping' → 'like GOING shopping' (like + -ing).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG.

1-DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  A: Where ARE YOU GOING?
  B: I AM GOING ice-skating.
  A: Can you ice-skate?
  B: Yes, I AM very good because I GO ice-skating every Saturday.
  A: Can I come with you?
  B: Of course.

2-DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  A: What DO YOU DO every weekend?
  B: We usually VISIT our grandparents. They LIVE by the sea.
  A: How DO YOU SPEND your time there?
  B: We usually SWIM in the mornings and PLAY tennis in the afternoons.
  A: What about the evenings?
  B: We often GO for a walk along the beach.

ZAMON TANLASH:
  1-dialog — HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish → Present Continuous
     (LEKIN 'every Saturday' bo'lsa → Present Simple)
  2-dialog — ODAT ('every weekend', 'usually', 'often')
     → butun dialog Present Simple

DIQQAT: 'be' fe'li -ing OLMAYDI → 'I AM very good'.

items.whyUz:
Hozir qayerga ketayotgani so'ralyapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
So'roq tartibi: Where + ARE + YOU + GOING?

'I' → AM + going.
'go ice-skating' = konkida uchgani bormoq.

'be' — HOLAT fe'li, -ing shaklida ishlatilmaydi.
'I AM very good' = men juda yaxshiman (bu ishda).

items.textEn: 1  B: ... because I 4) ............ (go) ice-skating every Saturday.
items.whyUz:
'every Saturday' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'I' bilan fe'l ASOS shaklida → GO.
2-band bilan solishtiring: hozir 'am going', odatda esa 'go'.

'every weekend' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
Birinchi 'do' — yordamchi, ikkinchisi — asosiy fe'l:
'What DO you DO ...?'

'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'We' — ko'plik → -S QO'ShILMAYDI.

DOIMIY holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'They' — ko'plik → LIVE.
'by the sea' = dengiz bo'yida.

ODAT haqidagi savol → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'How DO you SPEND ...?'
'spend time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq.

items.textEn: 2  B: We usually 5) ............ (swim) in the mornings ...
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'We' — ko'plik → SWIM.
'in the mornings' — ko'plik: har kuni ertalab.

items.textEn: 2  B: ... and 6) ............ (play) tennis in the afternoons.
items.whyUz:
Ega o'zgarmagan ('We') → PLAY.
'play tennis' — sport oldida artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 2  B: We often 7) ............ (go) for a walk along the beach.
items.whyUz:
'often' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'We' — ko'plik → GO.
'go for a walk' = sayrga chiqmoq; 'along the beach' = plyaj bo'ylab.

exercises.explanationUz:
17 ta test savoli — 1-8 unitlarning barcha mavzusi:
  chastota ravishlari, predloglar, bog'lovchilar,
  some/any, noto'g'ri ko'plik, Present Simple,
  egalik olmoshlari, taklif iboralari, miqdor so'zlari,
  'can', so'roq so'zlari.

Har bir savolga sabab keltirilgan.

items.textEn: 1  How ............ do you travel by plane?
items.uz: Siz qanchalik tez-tez samolyotda sayohat qilasiz?
items.whyUz:
'How OFTEN ...?' — chastota savoli (o'zgarmas ibora).
'sometimes' va 'always' — javob so'zlari, savolda ishlatilmaydi.

items.textEn: 2  What time does the plane ............ Paris arrive?
items.uz: Parijdan keladigan samolyot soat nechada yetib keladi?
items.whyUz:
'the plane FROM Paris' = Parijdan keladigan samolyot.
Samolyot Parijdan KELMOQDA → FROM.
'the plane TO Paris' bo'lsa 'Parijga ketadigan' bo'lardi —
lekin u holda 'arrive' emas, 'leave' bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 3  I don't like football ............ I love basketball.
items.uz: Men futbolni yoqtirmayman, lekin basketbolni juda yaxshi ko'raman.
items.whyUz:
Ikki QARAMA-QARSHI fikr → BUT (lekin).
'often' va 'sometimes' — chastota ravishlari, bog'lovchi emas.

'Have you got ...?' — MA'LUMOT savoli → ANY.
'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' va 'few' ishlatilmaydi.

'tooth' → 'TEETH' (noto'g'ri ko'plik, 6-unitda o'rganilgan).
Tishlar ko'p → ko'plik shakl.
'brush your teeth' = tish yuvmoq.

items.textEn: 6  We usually ............ out on Saturday afternoons.
items.uz: Biz odatda shanba kunlari tushdan keyin sayrga chiqamiz.
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'We' — ko'plik → GO ('goes' XATO).
'go out' = sayrga chiqmoq, ko'ngil ochgani chiqmoq.

items.textEn: 7  What's the weather like ............ London today?
items.whyUz:
SHAHAR nomi oldida IN.
'What's the weather like?' — 7-unitdagi asosiy savol.

items.uz: Menga bir oz shakar bering, iltimos.
items.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' va 'many' ISHLATILMAYDI.
TASDIQ gap → SOME.

OT bor ('house') → egalik SIFATI kerak: MY.
'ours' va 'mine' — egalik OLMOSHLARI, otsiz ishlatiladi.
11-mashqning 10-bandi bilan bir xil qoida.

'How about + ot?' — TAKLIF savoli, to'liq gap.
'Would you ... a hamburger?' — 'like' tushib qolgan → XATO.
'I'd like a hamburger' — savol emas, tasdiq gap.

'see' — sezgi fe'li, u bilan 'can' ishlatiladi:
'CAN you see ...?' = ko'ryapsizmi?
'Are you see' va 'Does you see' — grammatik XATO.

OG'IRLIK → HOW MUCH ('weigh' fe'li bilan doim shu).
6-unitda ham shu qolip bor edi.

'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.
7-unitdagi otkritkada ham bor edi: 'The children are IN their pyjamas.'

'some' bor → bu TAKLIF savoli → 'WOULD you like ...?'
'Do you like ...?' — umumiy yoqtirish savoli, 'some' bilan kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 15  How many ............ of ham do you want?
items.whyUz:
'ham' YUPQA kesib beriladi → SLICES.
'cartons' — sut/sharbat uchun; 'loaves' — faqat non uchun.
Coursebook 57-betdagi xarid ro'yxatida ham '20 slices of ham' bor edi.

OT YO'Q → egalik OLMOSHI kerak: HERS.
'her' — egalik sifati, otdan oldin: 'her book'.
9-band bilan solishtiring — teskari holat.

items.textEn: 17  A: ............ is his job?  B: He's a mechanic.
items.whyUz:
KASB so'ralmoqda → 'WHAT is his job?'
'Who is he?' — kimligini so'raydi (ism).
'a mechanic' = mexanik, usta.

wordFormation.introUz: 37-bet — egalik shakllari va eng ko'p uchraydigan xatolar.

groups.ruleUz: Egalik SIFATI va egalik OLMOSHI (yakuniy takror)
groups.explanationUz: OT bor bo'lsa — SIFAT; ot yo'q bo'lsa — OLMOSH.

items.derived: go for a walk along the beach
How do you spend your time?
I brush my teeth every night.

groups.ruleUz: Miqdor so'zi + OF + ot (qaysi ot bilan)
groups.explanationUz: Har bir miqdor so'zi ma'lum otlar bilan keladi.
Bu fe'llar bilan Present Continuous o'rniga 'can' ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Do/Does + ega + fe'l? — Yes, ... do/does.  /  No, ... don't/doesn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Do they play computer games? — Yes, they do. Does Mary like going shopping? — No, she doesn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular kompyuter o'yini o'ynaydimi? — Ha. Meri xaridga borishni yoqtiradimi? — Yo'q.

patterns.formula: What are + ega + LIKE? — They're + sifat.  (xarakter)
patterns.exampleEn: What are your sisters like? — They're very friendly and polite.
patterns.exampleUz: Singillaringiz qanday odam? — Ular juda do'stona va odobli.

patterns.formula: now/at the moment → Present Continuous;  every ... / usually / often → Present Simple.
patterns.exampleEn: Where are you going? — I'm going ice-skating. / I go ice-skating every Saturday.
patterns.exampleUz: Qayerga ketyapsiz? — Konkida uchgani. / Men har shanba konkida uchgani boraman.
patterns.explanationUz: Bitta fe'l, ikki zamon — vaqt so'ziga qarab tanlanadi.

patterns.formula: egalik SIFATI + ot  /  fe'l + egalik OLMOSHI.
patterns.exampleEn: This is my house. / Give this to Carol. It's hers.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu mening uyim. / Buni Karolga bering. Bu uniki.
patterns.explanationUz: OT bor → my/her/our.  OT yo'q → mine/hers/ours.

patterns.formula: How many + miqdor so'zi + OF + ot + do you want?
patterns.exampleEn: How many slices of ham do you want?
Can you see the boat? Can you hear me?
patterns.explanationUz:
see, hear, smell, taste — 'can' bilan ishlatiladi,
Present Continuous EMAS.
